title: Yuvion VL: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Adversarial Content and AI Safety
abstract: arXiv:2606.25034v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: General-purpose models often struggle to reliably identify and understand real-world multimodal risks, largely due to the inherent multimodal adversarial nature of content and AI safety. We present Yuvion VL, a family of multimodal large language models purpose-built for content and AI safety, with both instruction-tuned and reasoning-oriented variants. Yuvion VL addresses this gap by treating safety as an inherently adversarial and multimodal problem and designing the entire pipeline around adversarial robustness. For data construction, we develop an automated pipeline integrating adversarial-aware data synthesis with multi-stage quality control, producing large-scale, high-quality multimodal samples augmented with domain knowledge and reasoning annotations. For training, we adopt a three-stage pipeline that includes continued pretraining for risk-concept cross-modal alignment, instruct post-training for production-grade safet

translated_title: Yuvion VL：面向对抗性内容与AI安全的多模态基础模型
translated_abstract: 通用模型往往难以可靠地识别和理解现实世界中的多模态风险，这很大程度上源于内容和AI安全固有的多模态对抗特性。我们提出了Yuvion VL，这是一系列专为内容和AI安全打造的多模态大语言模型，包含指令微调型和面向推理型两种变体。Yuvion VL通过将安全视为一个本质上具有对抗性且多模态的问题，并围绕对抗鲁棒性设计整个流程，从而填补了这一空白。在数据构建方面，我们开发了一个自动化流程，将对抗感知的数据合成与多阶段质量控制相结合，生成了大规模、高质量、并经领域知识与推理标注增强的多模态样本。在训练方面，我们采用了三阶段训练流程，包括用于风险概念跨模态对齐的持续预训练、面向生产级安全的指令后训练……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Yuvion VL是专为内容和AI安全打造的多模态大语言模型系列，通过将安全视为对抗性多模态问题，采用对抗感知的数据合成、多阶段质量控制与三阶段训练流程，实现了对现实世界多模态风险的可靠识别与理解。
en_tdlr: Yuvion VL is a family of multimodal large language models purpose-built for content and AI safety, treating safety as an inherently adversarial multimodal problem through adversarial-aware data synthesis, multi-stage quality control, and a three-stage training pipeline.
